title: Top 3 CPU pods
intro: Build a leaderboard of the busiest pods for the capacity review.

objectives.text: Add a Table panel with the top 3 pods by pod_cpu_usage

hints: topk(k, expr) keeps the k largest series.
Panel type Table, query topk(3, pod_cpu_usage).
solution: Table panel with query topk(3, pod_cpu_usage)
debrief: topk runs at every step, so on a graph the top 3 can change over time. Tables show only the latest instant.
